title: 第八百零二章 追悔莫及第八百零一章 老邱的实力
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 自然有好事的人出现反问道：“到底是什么情况，为什么他们三个人可以通关了呢？到底通关是怎么样情况呢？”
“不是只有一个那个什么邱立秋通关吗？为什么有三个人同时离开的呢？”
“就是啊！
是不是这当中有什么漏洞啦？毕竟这个考验都已经存在千万年了，有错漏也是相当正常的事情啦！
这样对于我们来说很不公平的，这样真的是找谁说理呢？”
就此时，一个声音传来“他们三个人都是已经通关之人，并没有任何不公平的存在，大家都可以放心！”
这样一说，不由得让众人的内心为之而唏嘘的，毕竟这一句话对于他们来说打击是多么沉重的呢？
只有他们自己才真正地体会得到的，这样一来就已经让他们彻底地闭嘴了，毕竟他们还不敢这样地公然地针对黄泉路的规定啦！
这个明显是人在屋檐下不得不低头的节奏，甚至来说，很多东西还是需要他们好好地处理一下子的，不然就白白地浪费了那么好的机会啦！
渐渐地开始有人明白了这当中的原理，也有不少人通关成功的。
（很多人私下问为何邱立秋闯关时并没有其他人看到，然而冯斗和莫贵两个人闯关时，他们却可以互相看到呢？
其实这一点也是相当简单的，其实闯关时，可以选择一个人闯关，当然也可以选择多人闯关的，当然他们同时在里面就可以看到对方的闯关情况，如果像邱立秋这种喜欢独来独往的主，谁也没有办法知道到底里面发生了什么事情，才有了邱立秋闯关成功马上溜之大吉的情况。
所以其他人希望能够看到的，却一丝丝的机会都没有了，然而此时冯斗三个人来到了第四关时，他们彻底地凉了，尤其是莫贵和冯斗两人第一次来的，一下子就已经是蒙圈了，毕竟现在他们还是不知道接下来到底是什么情况了。
可是现在只有邱立秋一个人是来过的，其实当年是在这里闯过关的，结果就在这里却没有被对手击败，反而是被自己的身边人击败了，导致现在的情况来说，他才一开始时对于冯斗相当大的敌意啦！
这个就是与这第四关有着直接的关系，这个也是邱立秋之前一直都没有说的主要原因，就在此时，冯斗也有点急了，他笑问道：“究竟是什么情况呢？这第四关又是如何呢？”
莫贵笑道：“老邱，既然都已经到了这一步，那么我们接下来应该怎么样做呢？”
邱立秋听到他们两个人的话时，不由得叹气道：“很简单的，这一关采用相互配合的组队状态，以三个人为一队，夺得最后的成功，就可以完成最后的胜利，当然也是很简单的对战，那就是足够五队人之后就可以进行对战了，最后胜一队人就可以胜出了。”
莫贵反而有点愁容了，他反问道：“如果我们等不够五队人还不能够对战啦！”
“当然不是啦！
他们会根据实际情况来定，我感受这里很多东西都是他们人为选定的，至于到底是如何我就不知道了，如果到了最后他们确认无法组队时，那就是直接个人战了，我当年算得上毕竟比较好的，与人组队成功了，也一举夺得最后的成功，可是就在我认为自己已经是胜券在握时，却被同队的人直接干掉了，导致我原本已经是进入第五关的，结果却是被对方完全清除出了最后的入围圈啦！”
其实这样一来就已经是足够让冯斗明白这一切，以此同时，他充分地明白为何当初邱立秋会这样提防他，甚至来说，对于他是那种根本就不值得他信任的，以此同时，也是足够看得出他在对待冯斗和莫贵两个人之间完全是两种情况。
根本就不可一日而语的，同样一件事，邱立秋可以绝对地信任莫贵，却绝对不可能信任冯斗，原本病根却在这里的，这一来就已经完全地明白一切了，这样一来，就已经是能够让冯斗在某些程度上理解邱立秋的心情。
就在此时莫贵反而说：“这样来说，我们现在还需要等待他们通关之后，才可以进入下一关啦！”
“对的！
所以我现在需要好好地休养一番，等待接下来的大战，无论怎么样说，毕竟接下来是需要相互配合的，我们现在也是可以借此机会好好地配合一下子战术，不至于导致我们配合起来是那么不可一击的，毕竟他们这些人之中不乏高手的存在，既然要考虑配合了，那就不是个人争狠斗勇的，如果配合得好，也许真的达到了三个臭皮匠胜过一个诸葛亮的情况，这个也不是不可能的，毕竟很多时候，配合胜过很多的。”
就在这个时候，很多东西都已经开始准备了，然而此时他们三个人也得到相互有一定的信任，虽然还没有到达那种完全地将自己的后背交给对方的状态，也不至于会不信任对方的那种。
以此同时，冯斗也是渐渐地觉得这个邱立秋实在不是表面上那么简单的，其实很多时候，并不是冯斗不愿意将这一切告诉邱立秋等人，只不过是他不敢过于相信对方，毕竟很多东西都是没有办法完全地交代清楚的。
以此同时，冯斗就已经是足够让莫贵和邱立秋两个人吃惊的，他们在心里冯斗算得上一个二世祖一样的，但是与冯斗对战一次之后，他们就已经彻底地失望至极了，原本他们自认为最少可以做到镇压冯斗的。
可是一战之后，他们彻底地蒙圈了，他们虽然表面上有所心理准备，但是一战之后，却已经让冯斗在他们心里的地位彻底地改变了，甚至来说，他们根本就觉得自己以前从来就没有认识过冯斗一样的。
甚至有几次单独的对战时，就连邱立秋都觉得自己都已经是有点过分了，可是很快就已经被对方一下子打击到底了，他们万万没有想到的事情，那就是冯斗的战斗力是远远地超过他们的，甚至来说，有几次差点让冯斗彻底地翻盘啦！
因为有这个时间之后，他们就已经彻底地改变了对于对方的了解啦！
再加上他们相互了解之后，他们也是真正地了解到对方的强点，同时也是知道了对方的弱点如何，这样一来就已经是足够让他们配合起来，其实很多时候，也是希望能够做到的，
然而此时，邱立秋觉得这个冯斗也不是什么都不可以接受的存在，甚至来说，他都开始觉得冯斗的能力远远没有表面上那么简单，展示出来的战斗力，暗暗地远远地超越自己的。
如果邱立秋真正地明白一点，那就是冯斗一直都没有尽到全力，他会怎么样想呢？
会不会觉得冯斗在侮辱他呢？
就连莫贵也是相当不客气的，甚至来说，他也下狠手的，不然就不可能啦！
毕竟现在的情况来说，他不得不稳定地发挥的，以此同时，冯斗也很好地发挥啦！

Naturally, people with good intentions appeared and asked: "What is going on? Why can the three of them pass the level? What is the situation like passing the level?"
"Isn't there only one Qiu Liqiu who passed the customs? Why did three people leave at the same time?"
"That's right!
Is there any loophole in this? After all, this test has existed for tens of millions of years, so it is quite normal for there to be errors and omissions!
This is very unfair to us. Who are we really looking for to reason with this? "
At this moment, a voice came, "The three of them are all people who have passed the customs. There is no unfairness. Everyone can rest assured!"
Saying this, everyone couldn't help but sigh in their hearts. After all, how heavy a blow this sentence had to them?
Only they themselves can truly understand it. This has completely shut them up. After all, they don't dare to openly target the regulations of Huangquan Road like this!
This is obviously a rhythm that people have to bow their heads under the eaves. In fact, many things still need to be dealt with properly for a while, otherwise such a good opportunity will be wasted!
Gradually, some people began to understand the principle, and many people successfully passed the level.
(Many people privately asked why no one else saw Qiu Liqiu when he broke through the barrier, but when Feng Dou and Mo Gui broke through the barrier, they could see each other?
In fact, this point is quite simple. In fact, when you go through a level, you can choose to go through it alone, or you can choose to go through it with multiple people. Of course, they can see each other's progress when they are inside at the same time. If you like Qiu Liqiu, who likes to be alone, no one has a way to know what is going on inside. That's why Qiu Liqiu escapes immediately after successfully breaking through the level.
So what others hoped to see, but there was no chance at all. However, when Feng Dou and the three came to the fourth level, they were completely stunned. Especially Mo Gui and Feng Dou, who came for the first time, were confused all of a sudden. After all, they still didn't know what was going to happen next.
But now only Qiu Liqiu has been here. In fact, he passed the test here, but he was not defeated by his opponent here, but was defeated by the people around him. As a result, in the current situation, he was quite hostile to Feng Dou at the beginning!
This is directly related to the fourth level. This is also the main reason why Qiu Liqiu has not mentioned it before. At this time, Feng Dou was also a little anxious. He asked with a smile: "What is the situation? What about the fourth level?"
Mo Gui smiled and said: "Lao Qiu, now that we have reached this point, what should we do next?"
When Qiu Liqiu heard the words of the two of them, he couldn't help but sigh: "It's very simple. This level uses a cooperative team state. With three people as a team, you can achieve the final victory by winning the final victory. Of course, it is also a very simple battle. After five teams are enough, you can start a battle. In the end, you can win if you beat one team."
Mo Gui looked a little sad, and asked: "If we don't wait for five teams, we won't be able to fight!"
"Of course not!
They will decide based on the actual situation. I feel that many things here are artificially selected by them. As for how, I don’t know. If in the end they confirm that they cannot form a team, it will be a direct personal battle. I was relatively good at that time. I successfully formed a team with others and won the final victory in one fell swoop. However, just when I thought I had a chance to win, I was directly killed by someone from the same team. As a result, I had already entered the fifth level, but in the end, I was completely eliminated from the final round by the opponent! "
In fact, this was enough for Feng Dou to understand all this. At the same time, he fully understood why Qiu Liqiu was so wary of him in the first place, and even said that he was not worthy of his trust at all. At the same time, it was also enough to see that his treatment of Feng Dou and Mo Gui were completely different.
It is impossible to say things in one day. For the same thing, Qiu Liqiu can absolutely trust Mo Gui, but it is absolutely impossible to trust Feng Dou. The root cause of the disease was here. Now he has completely understood everything. In this way, Feng Dou can understand Qiu Liqiu's mood to a certain extent.
At this moment, Mo Gui said instead: "In this way, we still need to wait for them to pass the level before we can enter the next level!"
"Yes!
So now I need to take a good rest and wait for the next battle. No matter what, after all, we need to cooperate with each other. We can also take this opportunity to coordinate tactics for a while, so that our cooperation will not be so invulnerable. After all, There are many masters among them. Since we have to consider cooperation, it is not a matter of personal competition. If the cooperation is good, it may really reach a situation where three cobblers are better than one Zhuge Liang. This is not impossible. After all, cooperation is better than many in many cases. "
At this time, many things have been prepared, but at this time the three of them also have a certain degree of trust in each other, although they have not yet reached the state of completely handing their backs to each other, nor are they distrustful of each other.
At the same time, Feng Dou also gradually felt that this Qiu Liqiu was not as simple as he seemed. In fact, many times, it was not that Feng Dou was unwilling to tell Qiu Liqiu and others all this, but that he did not dare to trust the other party too much. After all, many things could not be fully explained clearly.
At the same time, Feng Dou was enough to surprise Mo Gui and Qiu Liqiu. In their hearts, Feng Dou was regarded as a second-generation ancestor. However, after fighting Feng Dou once, they were completely disappointed. Originally, they thought they could at least suppress Feng Dou.
But after the first battle, they were completely deceived. Although they were mentally prepared on the surface, after the first battle, Feng Dou's status in their hearts had completely changed. In fact, they felt as if they had never known Feng Dou before.
There were even a few separate battles where even Qiu Liqiu felt that he had gone a little too far, but he was quickly beaten to the end by the opponent. What they never expected was that Feng Dou's fighting power far exceeded theirs. In fact, Feng Dou almost made a complete comeback on several occasions!
Because after this time, they have completely changed their understanding of each other!
In addition, after they get to know each other, they truly understand each other's strengths and weaknesses. This is enough for them to cooperate. In fact, many times, they hope to be able to do so.
However, at this time, Qiu Liqiu felt that this Feng Dou was not unacceptable. In fact, he began to feel that Feng Dou's ability was far from being as simple as it appeared on the surface, and the combat power he displayed secretly far surpassed his own.
If Qiu Liqiu truly understood that Feng Dou had never tried his best, what would he think?
Do you think Feng Dou is insulting him?
Even Mo Gui was quite rude, in fact, he was ruthless, otherwise it would be impossible!
After all, given the current situation, he had to perform stably. At the same time, Feng Dou also performed well!
